Track equipment by the handoff—not a dot on a map.

Equipment tracking for the work you actually do.

Fieldmark focuses on QR-based accountability. Scan the label and record a move to a worker, job site, truck, or shop. The result is a practical current-location record and a history you can review.

Current location

See the last confirmed worker or location for an item.

Fast transfers

Move equipment in the flow of work without a special device.

Lasting history

Review every recorded movement before assuming it is missing.

What this is—and is not

Fieldmark is not GPS or fleet telematics. It is a straightforward system for the tools and equipment small crews pass between people and sites.
